column1: # memra#1321 review fold on one RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q card, third list (2026-11-18). LABEL<TAB>MODE<TAB>COMMAND; see maxq-cells.sh.
# 1. Exactness m7 vs s2i on the roomy card (the workspace parks); it records each process's peak and writes the tight targets.
# 2. The same items one at a time with the card held to the item's peak plus 768 MiB: the fold's prime calls end under the 2,048 MiB floor,
#    so it drops the workspace between calls and at the prime's end ([prime-ws] lines in the s2i logs are the proof the path ran).
# 3. A short cold prime placed after an unplaced 5.7k prime (the later reclaim): boots a (0,0,50) and b (0,0,100), this card's own charge.
